text: Refining D-0258: a contract may hold // and % by a positive integer literal, written as a plain int constant and not a bool, since neither fails on a number divided by one and the pinned Nagini divides by one as Python does, though not by a negative divisor; % takes only what the gate can tell is a number, since it formats a string, which can fail where Nagini's model of it can't; / stays refused, since a huge int over a literal can overflow converting to a float.
